text:
Quanto tempo sua equipe precisa para entender um concorrente?

No desafio apresentado pela Ford, a pesquisa manual leva cerca de uma hora por versão.

Com o SpecSync, você começa pela pergunta. A plataforma busca informações na internet, compara especificações de veículos e mantém as fontes acessíveis.

A equipe confere as evidências e avança para o que importa: a próxima decisão.
direction:
# AUDIO PROFILE
An original Brazilian male commercial voice, mature bass-baritone, with a deep chest resonance and a naturally rugged, slightly gravelly texture. Native Brazilian Portuguese, neutral Brazilian accent. A commanding automotive campaign delivery: strength, resolve, presence and controlled power.

## THE SCENE
A cinematic technology product film presented to Ford. The product is SpecSync. The voice has the weight of a major pickup-truck launch. The message remains credible and intelligible: the team researches, checks evidence and makes decisions. Record clean, dry studio speech, without music, effects or reverberation.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Speak only the exact Portuguese words under TRANSCRIPT. Do not read instructions or headings. Begin with low, contained intensity and build into an open, grounded projection when the product arrives. Speak from the chest with a dark, resonant timbre, a subtle natural rasp and strong articulation. Every sentence has intent. Maintain vocal authority through the ending of each sentence.
The opening question is a deliberate challenge. Allow it to land. Deliver the Ford briefing fact with deliberate weight on 'uma hora por versão', preserving both 'No desafio apresentado pela Ford' and 'cerca de'. At 'Com o SpecSync', open the voice and increase confidence and forward momentum. Give 'busca', 'compara' and 'mantém' distinct, decisive attacks while keeping the phrase flowing. The last sentence grows in resolve, then takes a deliberate pause before a powerful, low, definitive 'a próxima decisão'.
Use substantial contrast between quiet intensity, open projection and strategic silence. Keep diction clear. The power is in resonance, timing and conviction. Do not shout, growl, force the throat, whisper breathily, stretch words unnaturally, laugh or add filler. Avoid a smiling customer-support delivery. Do not mechanically stress every word. Do not imitate any identifiable real person's voice.
Pronounce SpecSync as the English compound 'spec sync', /spɛk sɪŋk/, joined smoothly. Never say 'especi cinco'. Say Ford naturally as a Brazilian Portuguese speaker would.

takes.label: Presença forte — grave e texturizada
takes.direction:
### THIS TAKE
Prioritize a distinctly deep, masculine, resonant and rugged voice. A deliberate pace around 125–135 words per minute; preserve expressive pauses instead of meeting a fixed duration. Give the opening room to create tension. About half a second after the question and after 'versão', a smaller pause before the product's actions, and a deliberate pause before the final four words. Let the product entrance carry a noticeable rise in energy. Finish low and firm, with a complete, resolved ending.
